reviewScope: All 340 rendered prompts were reviewed for originality, readability, category fit, and the KinPlay child-safety exclusions.

provenance.statement: No external prompt collection was used or copied.
provenance.method: The original 320 prompts were authored and reviewed on 2026-07-26. Twenty additional prompts were supplied directly by the project owner on 2026-08-05, assigned to the existing category model, rendered into final text, and checked for duplicates and prohibited material.

safetyPolicy.audience: Family use, approximately ages 4–8 with caregiver participation.
safetyPolicy.superGrossBoundary: Mild fictional bodily humor is limited to burps, farts, boogers, stinky socks, and harmless pretend messes.
